verifications.claim: Gene Hackman died at age 95 in February 2025 at his Santa Fe home.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The 95-year-old actor... Hackman's pacemaker showed an abnormal heart rhythm on Feb. 18'; R2: 'Hackman, 95... died on 18 February... Santa Fe'; R3: 'Hackman, 95... pacemaker last recorded... on 18 February... Santa Fe'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm age 95, death around Feb 18, 2025, in Santa Fe home.

verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state Betsy Arakawa as Gene Hackman's wife.

verifications.claim: Betsy Arakawa died of hantavirus about a week prior to Gene Hackman's death.

verifications.claim: Gene Hackman and Betsy Arakawa were found together on February 26, 2025.
